subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR wait for real embedded-agent proof of the internal-handoff drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths before merge?
rationale: The diff changes model-visible session-state repair semantics for six internal handoff tools, and tests plus CI do not prove the live embedded-runner behavior or settle the competing repair strategy.

options.title: Require runtime proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording show stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly accept the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Pause for strategy choice
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers choose between the internal-leaf drop approach here and the broader context-only preservation approach in the related open PR.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording show stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the active-turn queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced by PR #65478.
